summary.zh: 完善 Marketplace 原生插件与 Claude 技能包生命周期，加入包级开关、Manage Plugins 管理、持久化兼容绑定与更严格的安全校验。
summary.en: Completes native-plugin and Claude skill-package Marketplace lifecycles with package gates, Manage Plugins controls, persistent compatibility bindings, and stronger safety checks.

title.zh: 支持原生 Marketplace 安装与卸载流程
title.en: Add native Marketplace install and uninstall lifecycle

summary.zh: 原生 Marketplace 包现在通过 Studio 所有者确认的计划与执行流程安装或卸载，并在停用后保留可审计工件。
summary.en: Native Marketplace packages now use an owner-confirmed plan and execution flow for installation and removal, while retaining auditable artifacts after deactivation.

details.zh: 安装计划会展示能力、信任与网络影响，高风险操作需要所有者确认。
details.en: Install plans expose capability, trust, and network impact, with owner confirmation required for high-risk operations.

details.zh: 服务器路由与 Agent 规划工具共同执行所有者边界。
details.en: Server routes and the Agent planning tool enforce the owner boundary together.

sources.title: Add native Marketplace plan/execute lifecycle
feat(plugins): add Agent marketplace planner tool
feat: harden marketplace capability contract

title.zh: 在 Manage Plugins 管理 Marketplace 技能包
title.en: Manage Marketplace skill packages in Manage Plugins

summary.zh: Marketplace 技能包现在会出现在统一的 Manage Plugins 清单中，并支持安装记录协调、状态展示与卸载。
summary.en: Marketplace skill packages now appear in the unified Manage Plugins inventory with install-record reconciliation, status reporting, and uninstall support.

details.zh: 新增内置 Marketplace 管理技能，让 Agent 可以完成来源、计划、安装与清理流程。
details.en: A bundled Marketplace manager skill lets Agents handle source, planning, installation, and cleanup workflows.

details.zh: 技能包清单保持 GET /api/plugins 的原生插件数组契约不变。
details.en: The skill-package inventory preserves the native plugin array contract of GET /api/plugins.

title.zh: 可按包启用或停用 Marketplace 技能
title.en: Enable or disable Marketplace skills as a package

summary.zh: 新增全局包级启用开关；停用会阻止所有 Agent 使用该包，同时保留每个 Agent 的技能偏好。
summary.en: Adds a global package-level gate that blocks the package for every Agent when disabled while preserving each Agent's skill preferences.

details.zh: 已安装包在没有显式记录时默认启用，卸载时会清理包级状态。
details.en: Installed packages default to enabled without an explicit record, and uninstall removes package-level state.

details.zh: 设置界面缺少完整 activations 快照时会拒绝写入，避免覆盖并发状态。
details.en: Settings refuse writes without a complete activations snapshot, preventing concurrent state from being overwritten.

summary.zh: 重新组织 Marketplace 设置页面、来源区块与对话框，使刷新、启停和管理操作更清晰一致。
summary.en: Reorganizes Marketplace settings, source sections, and dialogs so refresh, enablement, and management actions are clearer and more consistent.

details.zh: 来源操作顺序、开关行为和插件管理表面现在保持一致。
details.en: Source action ordering, toggle behavior, and plugin-management surfaces are now aligned.

summary.en: Adds persistent Claude compatibility bindings and a Marketplace configuration control plane so source, activation, and access state remain consistent across sessions.

title.zh: 加强 Marketplace 生命周期与诊断隐私
title.en: Harden Marketplace lifecycle and diagnostic privacy

summary.zh: 安装计划、来源状态、并发写入与卸载清理现在具有更严格的一致性检查，并会隐藏远程诊断路径。
summary.en: Install planning, source state, concurrent writes, and uninstall cleanup now use stricter consistency checks, while remote diagnostic paths are redacted.

details.zh: Agent 安装会绑定注册表与来源快照，过期计划会在写入前被拒绝。
details.en: Agent installs are bound to registry and source snapshots, and stale plans are rejected before writes.

summary.en: Local builds now refresh artifacts when their content changes even if the version number stays the same.
